bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview 28000 Released - This build focuses on general improvements and platform changes for Insiders.
Windows 11 Insider Preview 26220.7070 Available - New features and improvements are rolling out to Dev and Beta Channels.
Microsoft Recognized as Leader - IDC MarketScape highlights Microsoft's excellence in application streaming and enterprise browsers.
Whisper Leak Cyberattack Discovered - A new side-channel attack threatens the confidentiality of language model communications.
Passkeys Now in Microsoft Edge - Edge introduces passkey saving and syncing for enhanced online security.
AI's Role in Cybersecurity - AI can both enhance and threaten cybersecurity, requiring careful management.
New Developer Resource for Microsoft 365 - Aimed at enhancing interoperability and data portability for developers.
Cloud Security Shift Highlighted by IDC - Organizations face increasing cloud security incidents, necessitating strategic changes.
SesameOp Backdoor Exploits OpenAI API - A novel backdoor uses OpenAI API for command and control communications.
